law_name: Republic of Palau Copyright Act of 2003 (RPPL No. 6-38)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (s. 16(a)); joint works life of last surviving author + 50 years (s. 16(b)); anonymous, pseudonymous, work-for-hire, audiovisual and collective works 75 years from publication or 100 years from creation, whichever expires first (s. 16(c)-(d))
notes: In force 26 Nov 2003; also protects performers. Commons (2018) said Palau was not then in Berne or WTO; may be outdated. Term from Commons summary.
